description: From the issued invoices exported by any accounting program: what is owed on a cutoff date by age past the DUE date (not due, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+), per customer sorted by who to chase first (amount × days overdue), the oldest invoices, DSO both simple and countback (which is not fooled by growing or seasonal sales), the average collection period of the last year, and the invoices agreed with more than the 60 days Spanish law allows between businesses. Prefer `path`: the ledger then never enters the conversation.

cutoff.description: Date of the snapshot (usually today or the end of a month)

dsoDays.description: Period of sales for the simple DSO

invoices.description: CSV of invoices as exported by any accounting program or spreadsheet: header in Spanish or English; separator , ; or tab; one row per invoice with its date and total (or net + VAT % − withholding %), and optionally number, customer, due date, payment date and outstanding amount. Alternative to path

name: receivables_aging
title: Receivables aging, DSO and average collection period from a CSV of invoices
